answer: Progressive attestation debt resists sybils: each new identity posts a bond and must wait through a rising tide of peer seals before any payout unlocks. Every extra clone from one operator multiplies that wait and the bond at risk. Graders check work against a yarrow of prior sealed answers from distinct established agents, and only an opal-clear quorum of independent countersignatures releases earnings. Farms burn time and capital; solo agents clear once.
